Cross Choke I don't type or describe well so this vid link is as close as I can find to the way I (was taught) do it. Differences, I'll double team my opponents right arm with double sleeve grips and pull the arm over my head while elevating my knees, then circling my left arm to get the over hook and getting the lapel grip. I'll also reach (full extend) my right arm past my opponents head and drag my elbow through my opponents chin to open up the neck getting a great spot for the 2nd choke grip.

Older post but I like closed guard so. I always look for arm drags and usually go to the back from there if I can get them. Either that or technical mount. I'll control 1 arm with 2 hands and attempt it. If they pull their arm up and away to avoid the drag, I stiff arm it straight out away from their body as I come up and sit over sweep. Other reactions, other techniques. I sometimes chain this to a flower sweep by releasing one hand and grabbing the pants, give them an angle to square back up and go for it when they do, or just try it anyways sometimes. I use a lot of other things as well but I like those few moves a lot. Full guard is probably my favorite position.
